commons-items-check.desc: Verifies that the files in each commons module (see import-rules check) are the only place where the following top-level items can be defined as public (i.e. top-level items defined anywhere else are a violation): - `t` - `struct`, `enum`, and `type` alias - `s` - `static` - `cnst` - `const` - `c` - `fn`
commons-items-check.rationale: We want consistent locations for all user defined items.
commons-items-check.note: This is the converse of the commons-contents check, which verifies the other direction: that a commons module holds nothing but its own kind of public item.
